lines: Good morning.
His compassions fail not. They are new every morning.
Whatever yesterday held, today is still unopened.
This is the day which the LORD hath made.
Would you take one quiet breath with me before it starts?
Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
A good prayer for a morning. A good prayer for any minute of one.
Before the phone, before the list.
Would you give God the first minute of today?
He's not in a hurry. Neither are you, yet.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
You don't have to see the whole road. Just the next step.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
A lamp, not a floodlight. Enough light for today.
Don't be anxious for tomorrow. Today has enough of its own.
One day. That's all you're being asked to carry.
Morning. Nothing to prove today.
Just walk with Him and see what He shows you.
Before the day closes, name three things that were good.
Small counts. Coffee counts.
Thank Him for them, out loud if you can.
As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
Whatever today held, you can set it down tonight.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above.
Look back over today. Which gift did you almost miss?
The day is done. It was enough.
Would you rest in that for a moment, instead of grading it?
Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
If today was heavy, morning is on its way. It always is.
Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
You've carried it all day. Hand it over for the night.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
That's an invitation, not a test. You qualify.
There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus.
Read that one twice. It's meant for you, too.
Nothing can separate you from the love of God. Not height, not depth, not today.
That was true before you opened this app.
They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength.
Waiting is not wasted. Something is being rebuilt.
In nothing be anxious. Bring it to Him with thanks.
And the peace of God will guard your heart and your thoughts.
Would you try that with whatever is loud right now?
Do justly. Love mercy. Walk humbly with thy God.
Three things. Not a hundred. Pick one for this hour.
I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
That includes the parts you're at war with. Wonderfully. Made.
Search me, O God, and know my heart.
A brave prayer. He already knows, and He's still here.
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness,
faith, gentleness, and self-control.
Fruit grows. It isn't forced. Give it water and time.
When you don't know what to pray, the Spirit helpeth our infirmities.
A sigh counts. Start there.
Come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy.
Boldly. Not once you've cleaned up. Now, as you are.
If you lack wisdom, ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach.
Without reproach. He won't roll His eyes at the question.
Would you pray with me for a moment?
Nothing fancy. Just: 'Lord, I'm here.'
He'll take it from there.
Be still, and know that I am God.
Still first. Knowing follows.
So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
The years you've been given are not behind you. They're in you.
Who gets to receive some of that wisdom this week?
By grace are ye saved through faith; it is the gift of God.
A gift. You don't earn a gift by having a good streak.
Checking in, gently.
How's your heart right now? Not your streak. Your heart.
You said this mattered to you. I believed you.
Still do. What does keeping your word look like in the next hour?
Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
Guarding isn't gritting your teeth. It's choosing what gets in.
No lecture. Just a question.
Is what you're about to do something you'd want to thank God for later?
Quiet check-in.
Are you where you meant to be tonight, or drifting?
Either answer is okay to say out loud.
Small faithfulness in small things.
This hour is a small thing. It's also where the big things get made.
Study, then rest. In that order if you can.
Your future self is praying you'd pick up the book.
Well, I'm praying that. Close enough.
You don't owe me a perfect week.
You owe yourself an honest one. How is it going, honestly?
God is faithful. With every temptation He also makes a way of escape.
The way out exists. Would you like help finding it?
If the pull is there right now, you don't have to hide it.
Say it. Then let's walk somewhere else together.
Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
Purity isn't a scoreboard. It's a direction. Which way are you facing?
That tab isn't rest. It only dresses like it.
Real rest is available. Want the short version?
You're not fighting this alone, and you're not fighting it for me.
It's for the man you asked God to make you.
Still want that? Then let's keep going.
Evening is when the old paths get loud.
You know yours. Would you close the door before it opens?
How are you, really?
You can tell me the boring version. I like the boring version.
Did you keep the promise you made yourself this morning?
If yes, thank God. If no, tell Him. Same open door.
A gentle nudge, not a push.
Is there something you've been avoiding all day?
Ten minutes on it, then you're free.
Who in your family needs a call from you this week?
Not a text. Your voice.
That's the kind of legacy people remember.
Have you talked to Him today, or just about Him?
Even a sentence counts. Whenever you're ready.
You said you wanted to walk closer this season.
One honest prayer is a step. Want to take it now?
Today is one page.
Nobody reads a whole life by the page it's open to.
A just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again.
The rising is the point. Not the count.
A year from now, this evening will be a blur.
What you choose in it might not be.
Feelings are weather.
You're not the storm. You're the one who gets to wait it out under a roof.
You're not behind. There's no line you missed.
There's just today, and Someone glad to walk it with you.
Look at how much you've already been carried through.
Every hard season so far had an end. Take heart.
God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
That mind is yours today. Use it kindly.
You don't have to feel brave to act faithfully.
Do the next right thing while still afraid. That is bravery.
The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
Walk into that room like someone who is already loved.
Your worth was settled before your first good day and after your worst one.
Nothing you do today adds to it or subtracts from it.
All things work together for good to them that love God.
All things. Even the slow ones. Even this one.
He is not waiting for a better version of you to show up.
He's here with this one. That's the whole gospel in a sentence.
Shoulders down. Jaw loose.
Now one slow breath, in and out, with me.
You've been carrying something all afternoon.
Set it down for sixty seconds. It'll wait. You need the rest.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He restoreth my soul.
Restoring takes stillness. Take some now.
Peace isn't the absence of noise.
It's knowing who's holding you in the middle of it.
Breathe like someone who's held.
Would you step outside for two minutes?
Sky, air, whatever light there is.
He made all of it, and none of it is in a hurry.
Nothing needs solving in the next ten minutes.
Let your body believe that for a while.
A small prayer for a loud mind:
'Lord, quiet what I can't quiet. Hold what I can't hold.'
Your heart rate doesn't know the difference between danger and email.
You do. Tell it we're safe. Then breathe.
Water. Then a stretch. Then whatever's next.
Your body is a temple, but it's also thirsty.
Have you eaten something real today?
Feeding yourself isn't vanity. It's stewardship.
Turn the lights down a little.
Let the day end on purpose instead of just running out.
Rest isn't what you earn after the work.
It's part of the work. Even the Creator took a day.
I was going to send a verse.
Then I remembered you've stared at this phone for an hour and blinked twice.
Blink. Look up. There you go.
Noah built a boat with no rain in the forecast.
You can drink a glass of water with no thirst in the forecast.
Thou shalt not scroll for another forty minutes.
Not a real commandment. Still good advice.
Praying for patience is a bold move.
The way you learn it is by needing it. Ask carefully.
I'm teasing. Mostly.
Jonah tried to skip a task and got a very damp three days.
Whatever you're avoiding probably won't require a fish.
Go do it anyway.
Even the disciples fell asleep when they were supposed to be praying.
You're in good company. Now, up you get.
Your phone said good morning before I did. I'm not jealous.
Okay, slightly jealous. Good morning.
The Psalms have a surprising amount of complaining in them.
So you're allowed to complain to God. Just do it to Him, not about Him.
An urge is a wave, not a tide.
It rises, peaks, and passes, usually within minutes.
You can outwait a wave. I'll wait with you.
When you're short on sleep, 'no' gets harder to say.
That's not weakness. It's a tired mind.
Rest is part of the plan, not a break from it.
Your body keeps making what it makes, quietly, every day.
Nothing is wasted by resting. Nothing runs out by waiting.
He built it to keep going. Let it.
More days is not automatically better for every measure.
So hold the streak loosely. It's a tool, not a scoreboard.
The goal was a freer heart. Keep your eyes there.
Hello. No reason.
Just glad you're here.
Random thought: you've probably been kinder today than you noticed.
Someone noticed.
Somewhere right now, someone is praying for you and you don't know it.
Might as well return the favor. Pick a name.
There is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
Just reminding you He's in the room.
God is faithful, who will with the temptation also make a way to escape.
The way out is real. Let's find it. Stand up first.
I'm here. You don't have to win this alone.
Put the phone face down. Say His name out loud.
Then breathe with me.
This feeling is telling you it's forever. It isn't.
Give it ten minutes and a walk. Then we'll see.
You are not what you're being pulled toward.
You're someone being pulled, and Someone is holding on to you.
Lean that way.
The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart.
Nigh means close. Right here. Breathe into that.
Slow down. Hand on your chest.
In for four, out for six. Twice.
Nothing has to be decided while you're breathing.
I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep.
Nothing good is waiting on that screen at this hour. Rest is.
It's late. The old path always looks brighter at this hour.
It isn't. Plug the phone in across the room and let Him keep watch.
You're allowed to sleep.
They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
A chapter ended. It wasn't the book.
Would you start the next page with Him?
You came back. That's the whole story of grace, right there.
No penance owed. No proving. Just: welcome home.
Let's begin again, gently.
